actionItems: Investigate the timeout issue in 'File upload using SPC420' test.
Analyze the flaky behaviour in 'RSS570 - Crystal Report' and 'SIMS_TB_SCHOOL - XQuery Report'.
Review the impact of recent changes on financial report tests.
Compare failure patterns between UAT runs before and after the pivot date.
Assess shared dependencies that may affect test stability.
executiveSummary: 3 tests regressed after the pivot date of 2026-10-26, with failure rates increasing significantly.
The 'File upload using SPC420' test failure rate rose from 0% to 20%, indicating a potential timeout issue.
Flaky behaviour was observed in two tests, which may suggest timing issues introduced by recent changes.
The 'NML510 - Trial Balance Report' showed improvement, decreasing failure rate from 50% to 40%.
Flaky behaviour in 'RSS570 - Crystal Report' and 'SIMS_TB_SCHOOL - XQuery Report' could reflect instability in the testing environment.
These issues may affect the reliability of financial reporting processes for users.
Further investigation into the timing and dependencies of these tests is recommended.
Comparing UAT runs before and after the pivot may help isolate the cause of regressions.
